messages:
sam-billing: FYI Polaris Labs (acct: PL-307) hit a payment failure during ACH setup. Bank webhook: `status: failed`, `decline_code: account_number_invalid_for_locale`, `bank_message: Account not eligible for ACH (non-US IBAN)`. Invoice 51420 ($6,450) is due in 48h; customer asks if we can accept an international wire to avoid interruption.
maria-payments: That error usually means they used an IBAN or EU account at onboarding. Do we have their country on file? If it's non-US we should switch to wire/SEPA.
sam-billing: Customer country = GB, they accidentally pasted IBAN into our ACH form. They offered to send an international USD wire today.
ops-oncall: Please pause autopay retries for PL-307 while this is unresolved to avoid double capture.
billing-bot: Payment attempt logged 2026-12-28 10:05 UTC (txn id: pay_z1x2). Status: failed. Retry scheduled per policy.
maria-payments: Quick compliance check: any prior disputes or high-risk flags?
nora-finance: No disputes, no chargebacks. Amount <$50k so standard approvals apply. Two items: (1) confirm customer will cover outgoing bank fees for international wire, (2) get signed one-off addendum for audit.
sam-billing: Customer says treasury will initiate wire but expects us to net fees on our side. They asked if Redwood can absorb bank fees for one-time courtesy.
cecilia-vpfinance: Approve acceptance of international wire for invoice 51420 ($6,450) conditional on customer either (A) including all intermediary fees so full invoice amount nets to us, or (B) if customer insists on deducting fees we require a signed exception documenting net amount and approval from finance. Which does customer prefer?
sam-billing: Told the customer they must cover fees; customer replied they can include fees. Asked for wiring details + remittance email.
maria-payments: I'll prepare SEPA/INT wire instructions. Also note: include SWIFT/IBAN and our correspondent bank for USD payout.
sam-billing: Wire details (sent to customer):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Global Trust Bank (US correspondent for GBP/EUR payouts)
Account (USD): 7011223344
ABA (correspondent): 026009593
SWIFT: GTBKUS44
Reference: Invoice 51420 - PL-307
Remittance: billing@redwood.ai
Note: Customer must ensure intermediary/beneficiary fees are paid so Redwood receives full invoice amount.
```
Please email remittance confirmation and attach bank trace when wired.
ops-oncall: Confirmed: support paused autopay retries for PL-307.
billing-bot: Flag created: INT_WIRE-5567. Audit note required: attach signed addendum and remittance email.
sam-billing: Customer replied: "Wire initiated, trace to follow, we covered fees."
maria-payments: Once funds post we'll reconcile USD equivalence and mark invoice paid. If bank deducts unexpectedly, follow Cecilia's instruction about signed net-amount exception.
nora-finance: I'll watch for the incoming trace; once posted I'll reconcile FX and close. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
